title: eavt
description: One generic EAVT row: exactly JSON fields e, a, v, and t. Generic EAVT preserves each coordinate as JSON; domain-specific attribute naming and time ordering are separate laws. Negation/contradiction are read from a fold across rows, never a polarity field on the row. SEAVT is a strict downstream specialization whose e, a, and v are closed RMN terms.
